subject: Welcome to Zelf!
title: Welcome to the Future of Identity
intro: You've taken the first step towards a more secure, decentralized digital life. By joining Zelf, you're part of a movement to reclaim your digital identity.
expect: Here is what you can expect from us:

benefits.item1: Exclusive updates on ZNS (Zelf Name Service) launches.
benefits.item2: Insights into our latest biometric security breakthroughs.
benefits.item3: Invitations to community events and early access opportunities.

philosophy: We are building a world where you don't need passwords or seed phrases, just you. Your face is your key.
